title: 第19章 陆宸的报复第20章 废丹田
content_zh:
进入混沌鼎世界后，陆宸先将通灵草种下，接着捏碎血灵芝，将碎屑埋进混沌鼎世界的土里。
种完通灵草和血灵芝，陆宸返回房间，施展凌霄步来到后山，开始了今夜的挖矿生活。
鼠爷虽然一直在啃着灵晶，但是注意力一直没有离开过陆宸，看到陆宸施展出凌霄步，并且坐拥一个矿，它的心里多了一些想法。
鼠爷笑着说道：“臭小子，该说不说，你的气运真是不错，居然什么好东西都让你遇到了。”
“本来我也是这么认为的，直到在坊市赌石买回了你。”
陆宸道，语气中带着几分怨气。
鼠爷笑道：“臭小子，别那么记仇嘛，以后只要你不犯我的忌讳，我肯定不会动手打你了。”
“再说了，遇上鼠爷，那对你来说也是一个大机缘，有了我，你以后可以得到无数的好处。”
陆宸上下打量了一下鼠爷，一脸嫌弃道：“好处我没看到，坏处倒是看到了，啥事不干，一天吃我大几千块灵晶。”
“臭小子，你把我放出去。”
看到被陆宸如此嫌弃，鼠爷不乐意了，脸一拉，嚷嚷着要出去。
陆宸不想放鼠爷出去，但为了不挨打，最后不情不愿的把鼠爷放了出来，道：“不在内世界好好待着，你又想作什么妖？”
鼠爷嗖的一声蹿到陆宸肩膀上，一边给陆宸捶肩，一边讨好的说道：“臭小子，别那么小气了，我帮你干活就是了。”
陆宸瞥了鼠爷一眼：“开什么玩笑，就你这样的能干活？”
“臭小子，你这是在看不起我。”
鼠爷愤怒道。
“哎，还真被你说对了，我就是看不起你，就觉得像你这样的，除了吃，啥用也没有。”
陆宸毫不客气的打击鼠爷，虽然伤好了，但他的气还没消呢，被一只老鼠教育了，真是脸都没了。
打击鼠爷的同时，陆宸暗暗发誓一定要揍鼠爷一顿，把丢掉的面子赚回来，要不然实在咽不下这口气。
“好，你给我等着，我今天必须让你知道我的厉害。”

话音未落，鼠爷伸出两个爪子，做出一副打架的姿势。
陆宸是被打怕了，只见他一个凌霄步闪开，一脸防备道：“鼠爷，你想干嘛，别揍我了。”
看着吓出神经反应的陆宸，鼠爷鄙视道：“你小子真是一个怂包，才揍你一顿，结果就吓成了这样。”
之后，鼠爷一闪而逝。
紧接着，陆宸看到鼠爷像个金刚钻一样，对着矿石壁一顿钻，眨眼的功夫，几立方矿石就被鼠爷挖出来了。
“好家伙，吃得多，这工作效率也惊人啊。”
看着眼前堆积成小山的土属性灵晶，陆宸算是长见识了。
说话的同时，陆宸也没闲着，有了一个挖矿的，他便着手将鼠爷挖出来的灵晶装进混沌珠世界。
后半夜，这一人一鼠形成了分工，鼠爷负责挖，陆宸负责装，矿脉中的灵晶在以极快的速度被挖掉。
清晨，鼠爷停了下来。
此时，整个矿脉的土属性灵晶被它挖空了，混沌珠世界也在一夜之间多了五千多万块灵晶。
这只是一个小型矿脉，能挖出五千多万灵晶，陆宸也满足了，在装起最后一块灵晶后，陆宸坐了下来。
一旁，忙活了一夜的鼠爷累瘫了，躺在地上一顿喘气。
鼠爷对陆宸道：“他奶奶的，刚苏醒，身体虚弱得和死了差不多，力量更是十万不存一，光是挖个矿，差点给老子累死。”
闻言，陆宸眼前一亮，一脸坏笑道：“鼠爷，你说如果我现在揍你，你还能不能打赢我？”
一听这话，鼠爷顾不得疲惫，一猛子爬起来，防备道：“臭小子，你可不能这么节操，趁我虚弱的时候欺负我。”
“和揍你比起来，节操算个毛啊。”
一声大笑过后，陆宸出手了，抓起鼠爷就是一顿揍，兴奋处，拎着鼠爷两条后腿拼命往地上拍。
一刻钟过去，鼠爷全身疯狂抽搐，两只眼睛已经翻白了，肉嘟嘟的小舌头也已经吐了出来。
如果不是知道这货是荒古遗种，没那么容易死，还有气，身体也没凉，陆宸都要以为打死了。

出了被揍的气，陆宸拎起鼠爷两条后腿，把鼠爷悬空吊着，突然心里感觉前所未有的爽。
鼠爷愤怒道：“臭小子，你混蛋啊，居然欺负老人家。”
陆宸撇嘴道：“鼠爷，来而不往非礼也，你揍我一顿，我也揍了你一顿，我们现在算是两清了。”
说着，陆宸将鼠爷扔进了混沌珠世界，让这货吃灵晶恢复状态，自己则疯狂填土，然后回到了房间。

content_en:
After entering the Chaos Cauldron world, Lu Chen first planted the psychic grass, then crushed the Blood Ganoderma and buried the debris in the soil of the Chaos Cauldron world.
After planting the psychic grass and blood Ganoderma, Lu Chen returned to his room, used Lingxiao Step to reach the back mountain, and started his mining life tonight.
Although Lord Mouse has been chewing on the spiritual crystal, his attention has never left Lu Chen. Seeing Lu Chen perform Lingxiao Step and sitting on a mine, he has some more thoughts in his mind.
Lord Mouse smiled and said: "You brat, you should say it or not, but you are really lucky. You have encountered all kinds of good things."
"I thought so at first, until I bought you back by betting on stones in Fangshi."
Lu Chen said, with a bit of resentment in his tone.
Lord Mouse smiled and said: "You brat, don't be so vindictive. As long as you don't violate my taboos in the future, I will definitely not hit you."
"Besides, meeting Mr. Shu is also a great opportunity for you. With me, you can get countless benefits in the future."
Lu Chen looked at Master Shu up and down, and said with a look of disgust: "I don't see the benefits, but I do see the disadvantages. If I don't do anything, I will eat thousands of spiritual crystals a day."
"You brat, let me out."
Seeing that Lu Chen was so disgusted, Master Shu was not happy. He frowned and shouted to get out.
Lu Chen didn't want to let Master Shu out, but in order to avoid being beaten, he finally reluctantly let Master Shu out and said, "If you don't stay well in the inner world, what kind of monster do you want to be?"
Lord Mouse jumped up to Lu Chen's shoulder with a whoosh, and while beating Lu Chen's shoulder, he said flatteringly: "You brat, stop being so stingy, I'll just do your work for you."
Lu Chen glanced at Master Shu: "Are you kidding me? You're the only one who can do the job?"
"You brat, you are looking down on me."
Master Shu said angrily.
"Hey, you are right. I just look down on you. I feel like you are useless except for eating."
Lu Chen hit Master Mouse unceremoniously. Although his injuries were healed, his anger was not gone. He was taught a lesson by a rat, and he really lost his face.
While beating Master Shu, Lu Chen secretly vowed to beat Master Shu and earn back the lost face, otherwise he would not be able to swallow this breath.
"Okay, just wait for me. I have to show you how powerful I am today."
Before he finished speaking, Mr. Shu stretched out his two paws and made a fighting gesture.
Lu Chen was frightened by the beating, so he stepped out of the way and said defensively: "Master Shu, what do you want to do? Don't beat me."
Looking at Lu Chen who was frightened and reacting nervously, Master Shu said with disdain: "You are such a coward. I just beat you up and ended up being scared like this."
After that, Lord Mouse disappeared in a flash.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Chen saw Master Shu drilling into the ore wall like a diamond. In the blink of an eye, several cubic meters of ore were dug out by Master Shu.
"Good guy, if you eat more, your work efficiency will be amazing."
Looking at the earth-type spiritual crystals piled up in front of him, Lu Chen gained a lot of experience.
While talking, Lu Chen was not idle. With a miner, he set out to put the spiritual crystals dug out by Master Shu into the Chaos Bead World.
In the middle of the night, the man and the mouse formed a division of labor. Mr. Shu was responsible for digging, and Lu Chen was responsible for pretending. The spiritual crystals in the veins were being dug out at an extremely fast speed.
Early in the morning, Lord Mouse stopped.
At this time, the earth-type spiritual crystals in the entire mineral vein were hollowed out by it, and the Chaos Pearl World gained more than 50 million spiritual crystals overnight.
This was just a small mineral vein that could dig out more than 50 million spiritual crystals. Lu Chen was satisfied. After loading the last spiritual crystal, Lu Chen sat down.
Beside, Mr. Shu, who had been working all night, was exhausted and lay on the ground panting.
Master Shu said to Lu Chen: "His grandma just woke up. Her body is so weak that she is almost dead, and her strength is at a loss. Just digging a mine almost made me die from exhaustion."
Hear the words, Lu Chen's eyes lit up, and he said with a bad smile: "Master Shu, if I beat you now, can you still beat me?"
As soon as he heard this, Master Shu didn't care about his fatigue. He stood up suddenly and said defensively: "You brat, you can't be so moral and bully me when I'm weak."
"Compared to beating you, moral integrity is nothing."
After a loud laugh, Lu Chen took action. He grabbed Master Shu and beat him up. When he was excited, he took Master Shu's hind legs and slapped him on the ground as hard as he could.
A quarter of an hour later, Master Mouse's whole body was twitching wildly, his eyes had turned white, and his plump little tongue had been spit out.
If he hadn't known that this guy was a relic from ancient times, he wouldn't die so easily, he was still angry, and his body wasn't cold, Lu Chen would have thought he was beaten to death.
Angry at being beaten, Lu Chen picked up Master Shu's hind legs and hung Master Shu in the air. Suddenly, he felt better than ever before.
Mr. Shu said angrily: "You bastard, you bastard, you actually bullied an old man."
Lu Chen curled his lips and said, "Master Shu, it's rude to come and go without reciprocating. You beat me up, and I'll beat you up. Now we're settled."
With that said, Lu Chen threw Mr. Shu into the Chaos Bead World, letting him eat spiritual crystals to recover while he crazily filled the soil, and then returned to the room.
